question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who supervises students in an examination hall
solution:
The correct answer is '**Invigilator**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate one word for the given group of words is '**Invigilator**'.
 
• It means 'a person whose job is to watch people taking an exam in order to check that they do not cheat (एक व्यक्ति जिसका काम लोगों को परीक्षा देते देखना है ताकि यह जांचा जा सके कि वे धोखा तो नहीं दे रहे हैं)'.
 
 
• *Example: If you need more paper, please ask the **invigilator**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Invigilator.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Inspector**: an official who visits schools, factories, etc. to make sure that rules are being obeyed, work is being done properly, etc. (स्‍कूलों, कारख़ानों आदि में नियमों के पालन आदि की जाँच करने वाला अधिकारी; निरीक्षक, इंस्‍पेक्‍टर)
 
• **Teacher**: a person whose job is to teach, especially in a school or college. [शिक्षक, अध्यापक, टीचर (विशेषतः स्‍कूल या कॉलेज में)]
 
• **Examinee**: a person taking an examination or test. (परीक्षा या परीक्षा देने वाला व्यक्ति)
